controls.input_condition: A verifier opinion is received for an installation report
controls.expected_action: Accept only verified, verified with comments, or not verified as the opinion state
controls.risk_prevented: Inventing unsupported verification outcomes

controls.input_condition: A report is promoted as verified satisfactorily
controls.expected_action: Require the opinion to be verified or verified with comments; not verified is not satisfactory
controls.risk_prevented: Treating an adverse opinion as compliant

controls.input_condition: A verified-with-comments opinion identifies unresolved legislative non-compliance
controls.expected_action: Create a permit-variation response path rather than closing the finding as informational
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving a legislative breach without a permit correction

controls.input_condition: A finding concerns failure to follow the approved monitoring plan, MMP, or permit conditions
controls.expected_action: Classify it as a non-conformity and retain its link to possible non-compliance or misstatement
controls.risk_prevented: Misclassifying monitoring-plan failures

controls.input_condition: A report contains an error or omitted information
controls.expected_action: Classify the issue as a misstatement and keep it in the verification findings ledger
controls.risk_prevented: Dropping data-quality errors from verification

controls.input_condition: A misstatement, non-conformity, or non-compliance is identified
controls.expected_action: Address the finding as soon as possible and before verification completion where feasible
controls.risk_prevented: Deferring known reporting defects without control

controls.input_condition: A finding cannot be resolved before verification activities finish
controls.expected_action: Tell the verifier why it remains unresolved so the verifier can assess the opinion
controls.risk_prevented: Concealing unresolved defects from the independent verifier

controls.input_condition: The verifier cannot provide verified or verified-with-comments status
controls.expected_action: Route the report to regulator determination of emissions and possible cost recovery
controls.risk_prevented: Using an unsatisfactory report as the compliance figure

controls.input_condition: A verified annual report has been returned by the verifier
controls.expected_action: Require the operator's final submission to the regulator in METS before marking the report formally submitted
controls.risk_prevented: Confusing verifier return with regulatory submission

controls.input_condition: The annual emissions report is amended after verification
controls.expected_action: Resubmit the amended report to the verifier before regulatory submission
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting changed data under an obsolete verification opinion

controls.input_condition: No compliant verified annual emissions report is submitted by 31 March
controls.expected_action: Flag regulator determination, regulator cost recovery, and possible civil penalty
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a late or invalid report as accepted

controls.input_condition: A regulator determines aviation emissions because reporting was late or erroneous
controls.expected_action: Record the determined figure in the operator holding account within one month of the determination notice
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving the compliance account without the authoritative determined figure

controls.input_condition: An installation improvement-report obligation is assessed
controls.expected_action: Distinguish tier or fall-back methodology reports from verifier-comment reports
controls.risk_prevented: Applying the wrong trigger and deadline logic

controls.input_condition: Major or minor source streams are not monitored at the highest applicable accuracy and lowest uncertainty
controls.expected_action: Require a tier-related improvement report through METS
controls.risk_prevented: Normalising avoidable lower-accuracy monitoring

controls.input_condition: The installation applies a fall-back monitoring methodology
controls.expected_action: Require an improvement report that justifies the approach and plans migration where practicable
controls.risk_prevented: Using fall-back methodology indefinitely without review

controls.input_condition: A lower tier or fall-back approach is reported
controls.expected_action: Document the reason and proposals to reach the highest tier as soon as reasonably practicable
controls.risk_prevented: Submitting an improvement report without a remediation plan

controls.input_condition: The operator proposes no monitoring improvement
controls.expected_action: Explain and support technical infeasibility or unreasonably high costs
controls.risk_prevented: Rejecting improvements without evidence

controls.input_condition: A new operator has a tier or fall-back improvement-report obligation
controls.expected_action: Set the first deadline to 30 June in the year after the permit was granted unless the regulator approved another date in writing
controls.risk_prevented: Applying the recurring schedule before the first-report rule

controls.input_condition: A category A installation has submitted its first tier or fall-back improvement report
controls.expected_action: Schedule subsequent reports by 30 June every four years
controls.risk_prevented: Using the wrong category cadence

controls.input_condition: A category B installation has submitted its first tier or fall-back improvement report
controls.expected_action: Schedule subsequent reports by 30 June every two years
controls.risk_prevented: Using the wrong category cadence

controls.input_condition: A category C installation has submitted its first tier or fall-back improvement report
controls.expected_action: Schedule a subsequent report by 30 June every year
controls.risk_prevented: Missing the annual high-category review

controls.input_condition: The verifier reports non-conformities or recommends improvements
controls.expected_action: Require a verifier improvement report by 30 June; apply the low-emitter exception only to recommendations, not to reported non-conformities
controls.risk_prevented: Overextending the low-emitter exception

controls.input_condition: The operator seeks exemption from responding to verifier findings in an improvement report
controls.expected_action: Require both resolution of all findings and submission of the related variation application before 30 June
controls.risk_prevented: Claiming exemption after completing only one prerequisite

controls.input_condition: A regulator-created operator holding account becomes available
controls.expected_action: Appoint a primary contact and at least one authorised representative
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving a compliance account without accountable users

controls.input_condition: The initial authorised representative is appointed under the permit-application charge
controls.expected_action: Limit the included permission to surrender allowances or return over-allocated free allowances unless an expansion is separately approved
controls.risk_prevented: Assuming unrestricted transaction authority

controls.input_condition: A legal person or individual uses a UK ETS trading account
controls.expected_action: Allow holding and trading only; do not use the trading account to satisfy operator compliance obligations
controls.risk_prevented: Surrendering or recording compliance through the wrong account type

controls.input_condition: Registry information is prepared for public display
controls.expected_action: Publish open-account and eligible historic transaction information while withholding authorised representatives, primary contacts, and detailed transactions less than three years old
controls.risk_prevented: Disclosing protected account-user or recent transaction information
